about: When a ROUNDS card pick happens. The pick is ROUNDS's own pick screen (5 cards, its rarity and duplicate rules), shown full screen while VS is paused; the card goes into ROUNDS's player at once.

columns.picks: tuning row giving the number of cards

rows.when: the party levels up in VS (in place of VS's level-up choice of weapons and items)
a VS treasure chest is opened (in place of its weapon and item rewards; its gold stays)
